announcements.buttonUnseen: What's new, you have unread updates
announcements.title: What's new

readingAndVocabulary.title: A quicker vocabulary test and a simpler reader
readingAndVocabulary.body: Get your first English vocabulary estimate after 8 questions. In the reader, look up words and save the ones you want to practise. You can turn automatic saving on in Settings. The iPhone app also has simpler navigation, a more compact dictionary and a new daily goal picker.

emailReminders.title: About email reminders
emailReminders.body: We may email you when a plan that does not renew on its own is about to end, and when you have words to review. You can turn these emails off in Settings, or with the link at the bottom of any of them.

installApp.title: Use Readfox like an app on your phone
installApp.body: Add Readfox to your home screen and read full screen from its icon. Settings shows the steps.

koreanSupport.title: Korean is now available
koreanSupport.body: You can learn Korean now. It has 8 free books and meanings in your own language. Add it from the language menu.

cardPayments.title: Card payments are live
cardPayments.body: You can now subscribe by card and the other methods shown at checkout, through Paddle. Alipay and WeChat Pay still work.

welcomeCode.title: For existing accounts: 15 days of Plus free with WELCOME123
welcomeCode.body: Open Settings → Plan, choose "Have a code?" and enter WELCOME123. You get 15 days of Plus, free. Valid until 15 December, once per account.

inviteCodes.title: Invite friends, get free Plus
inviteCodes.body: Share your invite link from Settings. When a friend signs up and starts reading, you both get a 14-day Plus card to activate whenever you like.

skipGuide.title: You can skip the first-lesson guide
skipGuide.body: The guide card in your first lesson now has a Skip guide button.
